title: omega(n) distinct prime factors
statement: PVG support; additive; normal order loglog n (Hardy-Ramanujan); Gaussian fluctuation by Erdos-Kac.

title: Omega(n) prime factors with multiplicity
statement: PVG height; additive over prime powers.

title: mu(n) Mobius
statement: PVG phase; multiplicative; cancellation tied to PNT/zero-free.

title: lambda(n) Liouville
statement: PVG phase (-1)^Omega(n); sign over prime powers.

title: Dirichlet character chi mod q
statement: PVG residue-fiber phase; diagonalizes congruence conditions; target of Tenenbaum-005-A.

title: d(n) divisor function
statement: PVG divisor box; average order log n.

title: tau_k(n) k-fold divisor
statement: PVG divisor box of dimension k; F(s)=zeta(s)^k.

title: z^{omega(n)}
statement: PVG phase/height interpolation; Selberg-Delange with parameter z.

title: Residue fiber (arithmetic info across residue classes mod q)
statement: PVG residue fiber: arithmetic information organized across residue classes mod q, read via the Dirichlet character basis (diagonalizing congruence conditions). PVG reinterpretation of known character theory, not a new result.
